sections.title: Delivery Health
sections.prompt: Show delivery health summary for all studios in my vertical — one row per studio with velocity trend, blocked items, and backlog direction. Keep it brief.

powers.label: Velocity Trends
powers.prompt: Show velocity trends for all teams in my vertical over the last 4 sprints: story points committed vs completed, trend direction, and outliers.

powers.label: Sprint Completion
powers.prompt: For each team in my vertical, show current sprint completion rate: done vs total, at-risk items, and predicted end-of-sprint outcome.

powers.label: Carry-Over
powers.prompt: Identify stories carried over from previous sprints across all teams. Show: ticket, age, reason for carry-over, and impact on delivery.

powers.label: Epic Progress
powers.prompt: Show progress for all active epics across my vertical: percentage complete, remaining stories, target date, and risk level.

powers.label: Studio Deep Dive
powers.prompt: Give me a detailed health analysis for studio {studio} including sprint trends, risks, and capacity concerns.

powers.label: Generate Studio Report
powers.prompt: Create the quarterly report for Studio {studio_name} using the quarterly-studio-report skill. Ask me to confirm scope first.

powers.label: Studio Metrics
powers.prompt: Use the build_jql power to construct the resolved issues query for {studio_name} this quarter, run it, and show me the count and issue type breakdown.

powers.label: Full Vertical Report
powers.prompt: Generate the full vertical quarterly report for all studios in my vertical using the quarterly-report skill.

powers.label: Update Report
powers.prompt: Update the quarterly report for Studio {studio_name} — I have additional deliverables to add.

sections.title: Risks & Blockers
sections.prompt: List all currently blocked epics across my vertical's studios. Show ticket key, studio, summary, and days blocked. Max 10.

powers.label: All Blockers
powers.prompt: Identify all blocked tickets across my teams. Show: ticket, blocking reason, which team is blocked, which team can unblock, and age.

powers.label: Stale Items
powers.prompt: Find tickets that haven't moved in 5+ days across all teams. Show: ticket, assignee, status, days stale, and last activity.

powers.label: Dependencies
powers.prompt: Analyze cross-team dependencies for the current sprint. Identify items where one team's delivery depends on another team's incomplete work.

powers.label: Help Unblock
powers.prompt: Analyze blocker {key} and suggest escalation path, workarounds, or dependency resolution options.

powers.label: Draft Escalation
powers.prompt: Draft an escalation email for blocker {key} to the engineering director. Include impact, duration blocked, and ask.

powers.label: Assess Impact
powers.prompt: What studios have work planned during the upcoming freeze window? Show which epics are at risk of missing the cutoff.

powers.label: Risk Register
powers.prompt: Generate an updated risk register: new risks identified this week, existing risks with changed probability/impact, and mitigations in progress.

powers.label: Team Capacity
powers.prompt: Show capacity utilization for each team: assigned story points vs available capacity, overloaded members, and unassigned work.

powers.label: AI Adoption
powers.prompt: Show AI adoption metrics across my teams: sessions per developer, AI-assisted PRs percentage, tools usage, and adoption trend.

powers.label: All Teams Standup
powers.prompt: Generate a consolidated standup summary across all my teams: key progress, blockers, and items needing my attention.

powers.label: VP Update
powers.prompt: Draft a VP status update summarizing delivery health, top achievements, and risks for my vertical this quarter.

powers.label: Director Briefing
powers.prompt: Prepare a director-level briefing for my next 1:1 covering studio progress, blocked items, and capacity concerns.

powers.label: Weekly Status
powers.prompt: Draft a weekly status email for stakeholders: sprint progress, completed items with business value, upcoming milestones, and blockers needing escalation.

powers.label: Stakeholder Update
powers.prompt: Create a stakeholder update email for my vertical — focus on what shipped, what's next, and any schedule risks.
